get_config_H4: get the FermiNet configuration for a four hydrogen atom system on a circle
set_geometry_H4: set the molecular geometry for four hydrogen atoms arranged on a circle
run_H4_VMC: run a variational Monte Carlo calculation on the H4 molecule using FermiNet
modify_H4_radius: modify the H4 configuration radius to change the distance of hydrogen atoms from center
modify_H4_angle: modify the H4 configuration angle to change the angular separation of hydrogen atoms
